speaker: Doctor
text: That is excellent news regarding your psychiatric improvement; the risperidone is likely working well. text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms you describe—restlessness, fidgeting, and repetitive leg movements—sound like akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. Have you noticed any worsening of these sensations since taking your first dose, or do they occur consistently throughout the day?
